plain_idea.one_liner: Use the distance between an enhancer and its gene's promoter to predict how strongly the enhancer switches that gene on.
plain_idea.train_on: Enhancer-gene pairs with their linear genomic distance and sequence; number of examples unknown, because this review provides no data.
plain_idea.predict: The measured effect of an enhancer on its target gene's expression. This would have to come from other papers' perturbation screens, not from this one.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Groups studying how enhancers work over long distances would learn how much distance alone limits enhancer effect, but this paper supplies none of the data.

ml_idea: None from this paper. Enhancer-gene link prediction (for example from CRISPRi perturbation screens) is a separate, crowded task and would need its own source dataset.
